svg.title: INDEX cursor design review - three pointer concepts
svg.desc: A pixel arrow, B needle arrow, C INDEX finger. Each shows a four-times enlarged view, plus 24, 32 and 48 pixel samples against dark and light surfaces. All lettering is outlined pixel typography. Review only, nothing activated. Actual size applies at 100 percent zoom.

g.aria-label: THREE VECTOR CONCEPTS. SELECT A DIRECTION.
